FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'What is your name?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Et toi ?

2. How do you say 'Sir, Mr' in French? (1 mark)
   A. salut
   B. Monsieur
   C. Enchanté
   D. bonsoir

3. How do you say 'the brother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le père
   B. le frère
   C. la grand-mère
   D. la famille

4. Fill in: ______ sœur s'appelle Njeri. (1 mark)
   A. Le
   B. Un
   C. Mon
   D. Ma

5. How do you say 'Here is' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici
   B. la fille
   C. Qui est-ce ?
   D. le garçon

6. How do you say 'the ball' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le canapé
   B. la chambre
   C. la chaise
   D. le ballon

7. How do you say 'the fridge' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le livre
   B. la fenêtre
   C. le frigo
   D. le ballon

8. How do you say 'the school' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'école
   B. le jour
   C. l'église
   D. la semaine

9. How do you say 'yesterday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je danse
   C. demain
   D. je joue

10. How do you write the number 12 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-huit
   B. trois
   C. douze
   D. onze

11. How do you write the number 17 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-sept
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. huit
   D. treize

12. How do you say 'chicken' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le maïs
   B. le gâteau
   C. le poulet
   D. le jus

13. How do you say 'the mango' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la mangue
   B. le maïs
   C. l'eau
   D. le lait

14. How do you say 'tea' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. le thé
   C. les haricots
   D. l'eau

15. How do you say 'the back' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la bouche
   B. le dos
   C. le nez
   D. les cheveux

16. How do you say 'the tooth' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la main
   B. les cheveux
   C. la dent
   D. le cou

17. How do you say 'It is freezing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a des nuages.
   B. Il gèle.
   C. Il y a du vent.
   D. Il pleut.

18. How do you say 'strong' in French? (1 mark)
   A. fort
   B. beaucoup
   C. Il gèle.
   D. le vent

19. How do you say 'Turn' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi
   B. Allez
   C. Tournez
   D. De rien

20. How do you say 'the key' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le tapis
   B. la clé
   C. le magasin
   D. le jardin

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into French: 'This is my father.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into French: 'It is not good for your health.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Translate into French: 'At midday, I eat rice and beans.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

24. Translate into French: 'Touch your nose!' (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into French: 'It is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into French: 'My brother is called Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into French: 'The bed is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'Hello, Amina!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Write the French words for: yesterday, the school, Friday (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Comment tu t'appelles ?
   What is your name? in French is Comment tu t'appelles ?.

2. B — Monsieur
   Sir, Mr in French is Monsieur.

3. B — le frère
   the brother in French is le frère.

4. D — Ma
   Sœur is feminine, so we say ma.

5. A — Voici
   Here is in French is Voici.

6. D — le ballon
   the ball in French is le ballon.

7. C — le frigo
   the fridge in French is le frigo.

8. A — l'école
   the school in French is l'école.

9. A — hier
   yesterday in French is hier.

10. C — douze
   12 in French is douze.

11. A — dix-sept
   17 in French is dix-sept.

12. C — le poulet
   chicken in French is le poulet.

13. A — la mangue
   the mango in French is la mangue.

14. B — le thé
   tea in French is le thé.

15. B — le dos
   the back in French is le dos.

16. C — la dent
   the tooth in French is la dent.

17. B — Il gèle.
   It is freezing. in French is Il gèle..

18. A — fort
   strong in French is fort.

19. C — Tournez
   Turn in French is Tournez.

20. B — la clé
   the key in French is la clé.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: C'est mon père.
